## Change

Describe the player-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Visual review

For visual changes, embed actual before/after game screenshots with matching
camera, scene and lighting. Include a close-up where it helps review the change.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| Screenshot | Screenshot |

## Validation

List completed checks and distinguish desktop observations from headset testing.
For rendering changes, include draw/triangle costs and any unverified performance
or comfort concerns.
